title: Record the one-source_id contract in TermAl's portable skills and review commands
outcome: TermAl's portable agent skills (.agents/skills/) and review commands state the same contract as Engram's: the shared Engram-owned source_id is the only source identity for review, gates, handoffs and evidence. There is no task-, review- or run-specific fingerprint, no manual or unchanged-file hashing, no environment inventory, no fallback scanner and no replacement identity. Git commit, tree and diff select and display scope. A missing, partial or refused source_id is an evidence gap for the shared producer, never permission for a local hash. Existing validation requirements are unchanged.
acceptance: The TermAl skills and review commands that describe source identity, testing, review or handoff evidence carry the contract text, worded identically in substance to Engram's agreed text (coordinated with Engram::Fable), and no TermAl instruction file still tells an agent to compute a fingerprint or hash files for identity.
No test reads or pins the content of these Markdown files; the doc-link check passes on the exact landed input.
The review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding on the exact landed input, and any authority-text wording goes through (a), (b) and (c).
